title: Machine-learning alert flags supernova 2023zkd as a black hole and star binary merger
summary: The LAISS machine-learning alert system flagged the transient SN 2023zkd months before its most unusual behaviour, and the team then analysed its four-year optical precursor. The authors conclude that a massive, partly stripped helium star merged with a black hole companion, with the second light peak explained by a collision with a dense disk-like cloud. The ML step only prioritised the event; the physical interpretation is model-based, and outlets give conflicting accounts of who first detected it.
ai_technology: LAISS machine-learning anomaly alert for transient detection
